first_experiment.title: Tally 7 enterprise AE postings against what you do today

hypothesis.statement: The main gap between this user's current work and enterprise AE roles is multi-stakeholder deal management, not product knowledge or raw quota attainment.
hypothesis.would_be_wrong_if: Most postings' recurring requirements are ones you already meet, or the top gap is something else (e.g., industry experience).

relevance.why_for_this_user: You want to move to enterprise but haven't mapped the gap; this uses public postings and never touches a live deal.

steps.instruction: Find 7 current enterprise AE postings in your market, including your own company's if one exists.
List the requirements that recur in at least 3 postings.
Mark each as met, partly met, or missing, based on your last 6 months of deals.
Note the top 2 gaps and anything that surprised you.

materials.description: Public job postings; nothing from the CRM or live deals.

prediction.user: I'll be missing 'bigger deal sizes', and that's about it.
prediction.engine: Expect gaps in multi-threading across many stakeholders and in executive-level conversations, alongside deal size.

learning_criteria.confirms_if: Multi-stakeholder deal management is among the top 2 gaps and most other requirements are met or partly met
learning_criteria.disconfirms_if: The top gaps are elsewhere, or you already meet nearly all recurring requirements
learning_criteria.informative_note: Postings are indicative local evidence (E2), not a verified market fact.
